==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this spell on any target, including foes who do not attack. Once cast on a target, the Hero will not recast it on that target until the hex has expired, even if the target is attacking.

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] is similar to [[Reckless Haste]].
